question: When total realized government outflow is capital-constrained to nearly the same amount, does a higher political budget ceiling worsen state outcomes by front-loading spending and crowding out state-regeneration expenditure?
tests: Compare 5x versus 20x first: if cumulative total outflow differs by <1% but 20x spends materially earlier and has lower state-regeneration outflow or worse final outcomes, classify as pacing/crowd-out evidence.
Report first day government capital falls below 10% of anchor capital.
Report fraction of total outflow consumed by political order versus state regeneration.
Do not interpret internal capital as real dollars.
